categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Fines resolved through prompt payment before formal enforcement and penalties.
categories.rationale: Directly maps to the timely payment task realizing fast revenue recovery without formal notification or penalties.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Fines resolved through payment occurring after formal notification and added penalties.
categories.rationale: Maps to delinquent payment following the enforcement path with notification and penalty surcharge.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Fines contested through the administrative appeal channel directed to the Prefecture.
categories.rationale: Traces to administrative appeal handling steps including filing, transmission, and ruling from the Prefecture.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Fines contested through the judicial appeal channel directed to a Judge.
categories.rationale: Maps directly to the judicial appeal alternative providing independent review.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Fines recovered through coercive credit collection procedures following unfulfilled enforcement.
categories.rationale: Traces to the coercive credit collection task used when voluntary or non-appeal resolutions are absent.
